User flow A: tìm cố vấn, tư vấn và quay: User flow A: find an adviser, consult and come back
Từ Home, người dùng xem Ranking, tìm the: From Home, users check the Ranking, search by topic in the Supporter list, or get a notice that a favourite adviser is online, then reach Supporter detail. Without enough points they buy or earn some and come back. With enough points they choose chat to open Chat detail, or a call: confirm the call, connecting, and if the adviser doesn’t answer the app suggests switching to chat. When the adviser answers: on the call, a quick top-up to keep talking, end the call and see the summary. Both branches end at Review (Good/Bad, can be skipped) and the consultation is saved in Chat history.
User flow B: đăng ký bằng karte hội thoạ: User flow B: sign up through the conversational karte
Lần đầu mở app, người dùng thấy First sc: On first opening the app, users see the First screen. With an account, they sign in with email and password; if they forget the password they go through Account reissue 1 (enter email) and Account reissue 2 (new password) and sign in again, and a wrong entry shows one of 5 error cases. Without an account, the conversational karte asks in turn for a display name, gender, date of birth and concerns (up to 5). An invalid name or date of birth gets an error right in the chat bubble so it can be re-entered or re-picked; under 18, sign-up stops. Finally users review the karte card, edit any item and enter Home.
